versions.content: Transformation of ECUC model according to the AUTOSAR XML Schema Production Rules Type: valid Description: The ECU Configuration Template schema shall be derived using the model transformation described in the AUTOSAR XML Schema Production Rules. Rationale: The experience and tools already available for the AUTOSAR Modeling from other templates shall be reused. Use Case: The template for the ECU Configuration is similar to other templates already done within AUTOSAR. Dependencies:  Supporting Material: AUTOSAR XML Schema Production Rules [7].
